title.original: Benchmarking Open-Ended Multi-Agent Coordination in Language Agents
title.zh: 语言智能体开放式多智能体协调基准评测
title.en: Benchmarking Open-Ended Multi-Agent Coordination in Language Agents

inclusion_reason.zh: alem 提供 JAX 并行环境、程序化协调难度和分离奖励，是长期开放式多 Agent 训练与评测底座。
inclusion_reason.en: alem provides a parallel JAX environment, procedural coordination difficulty, and separated rewards as a foundation for long-horizon multi-agent training and evaluation.

abstract.zh: alem 是基于 JAX 的开放式多 Agent 生存世界，将程序化协作任务、软专长、通信和难度控制嵌入探索、制作、交易与战斗。
abstract.en: alem is a JAX-based open-ended multi-agent survival world embedding procedural coordination tasks, soft specialization, communication, and controllable difficulty into exploration, crafting, trade, and combat.

problem.zh: 现有评测通常只考单 Agent、短交互或高度结构化合作，无法同时测量长时程计划、角色分配和开放式协调。
problem.en: Existing evaluations usually isolate single agents, short interactions, or highly structured cooperation and cannot jointly measure long-horizon planning, role allocation, and open coordination.

approach.zh: 基准在可程序化的 Craftax 式世界中控制协调难度，让同模型团队零样本协作，并以训练充分的 MARL Agent 作为参照。
approach.en: The benchmark controls coordination difficulty in a procedural Craftax-like world, evaluates homogeneous LLM teams zero-shot, and compares trained MARL references.

system_design.zh: JAX 环境并行模拟局部观测、资源、角色能力、消息和团队奖励，记录基础任务收益与协调收益以分离两类能力。
system_design.en: The JAX environment parallelizes local observations, resources, role capabilities, messages, and team rewards, separating base-task return from coordination return.

key_results.zh: 当前 LLM 整体远未解决该环境，且强单体任务收益不保证协调收益；通信是最大贡献因素，记忆和推理主要帮助维持多步计划。
key_results.en: Current LLM teams remain far from solving the environment, and strong individual-task return does not ensure coordination; communication contributes most, with memory and reasoning aiding plans.

limitations.zh: 同质、零样本团队和游戏化世界不能覆盖现实组织的异构工具、持久身份、经济激励或人类参与。
limitations.en: Homogeneous zero-shot teams in a game world do not cover heterogeneous tools, persistent identity, economic incentives, or human participation in real organizations.

baselines: MARL agents trained for one billion steps

metrics.name: Average normalized return of evaluated LLM agents

notes.zh: 上述非空 evaluation 字段和数值仅转录自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未披露的表格级条件、硬件与集群配置及更多对照项仍待全文审计。
notes.en: The non-empty evaluation fields and numbers above are transcribed only from the official arXiv abstract; table-level conditions, hardware and cluster configurations, and additional comparisons not stated there await full-text audit.
